s1.syndrome_frame: Facial asymmetry in a neonate with a cerebellopontine angle mass
salient_findings: Enhancing mass in the left cerebellopontine angle and internal auditory canal
Profound hearing loss in the left ear
key_facts: 4-week-old male patient
Left facial asymmetry observed during crying
Passed infant hearing screening
MRI showed an enhancing mass in the left cerebellopontine angle and internal auditory canal
Follow-up MRI showed considerable growth of the mass
ABR testing demonstrated profound hearing loss in the left ear
Histopathological examination revealed a vascular lesion with low levels of mitotic activity
Biphasic lesion composed of vascular nodules among spindle cells
Glomeruloid-like architecture of vascular epithelial nodules

Histopathological examination revealed a vascular lesion with low levels of mitotic activity

shortlist.label: Hemangioma
shortlist.why_kept: MRI showed an enhancing mass, histopathological examination revealed a vascular lesion with low levels of mitotic activity

shortlist.label: Lymphangioma
shortlist.why_kept: Glomeruloid-like architecture of vascular epithelial nodules, pattern similar to lymphangiomatosis

shortlist.label: Congenital hemangioma
shortlist.why_kept: Vascular lesion with low levels of mitotic activity, considerable growth of the mass on follow-up MRI

shortlist.label: Lymphangiomatosis
shortlist.why_kept: Pattern similar to lymphangiomatosis, biphasic lesion composed of vascular nodules among spindle cells

shortlist.label: Plexiform neurofibroma
shortlist.why_kept: Left facial asymmetry, histopathological examination revealed a vascular lesion with low levels of mitotic activity

raw.rationale: The patient's age, MRI findings of an enhancing mass, and histopathological examination revealing a vascular lesion with low mitotic activity and glomeruloid-like architecture are consistent with congenital hemangioma, which is known to be present at birth and can cause significant growth in the first few weeks of life.

rejected.label: Hemangioma
rejected.why: Typical hemangiomas are not usually present at birth and have a different growth pattern

rejected.label: Lymphangioma
rejected.why: Lymphangiomas are typically composed of lymphatic vessels and do not have the same biphasic pattern of vascular nodules among spindle cells

rejected.label: Lymphangiomatosis
rejected.why: Lymphangiomatosis is a more diffuse process involving multiple lymphatic vessels and is not typically characterized by a localized mass

rejected.label: Plexiform neurofibroma
rejected.why: Plexiform neurofibromas are associated with neurofibromatosis type 1 and have a distinct histological appearance with a plexiform pattern of nerve sheath tumor cells
